name: edge-blur
title: Edge Blur
blurb: Graduated blur overlay at top or bottom edge using backdrop-filter masks.
description: Fixed-position overlay with layered backdrop-filter blur fading via mask-image gradient. Provides TopBlur and BottomBlur convenience exports.
use_when: Fading content at edges to prevent text cutoff or create aesthetic transitions between sections.
avoid_when: On browsers without backdrop-filter support, or when blur must track scrollable content — uses fixed positioning.
a11y: Purely decorative overlay with pointer-events-none and no semantic content.
